notes.title: Level Editor Small Update
notes.content:
News:

Added filter buttons on level creation screen.
Added a new background to the level editor.
Added two new blocks to the level editor

Bugs:

Fixed bug that caused balls to report at odd angle when hitting a snow block.

notes.title: Early Acess Next Updates
notes.content:
In this post I'll provide a summary with the major additions planned for the next game updates and an estimate of when it will be available:

July:
• Third Basic Mascot
• Power Up shop at the beginning of phases
• World 3 (Crystal Caves)
• Hat system for pets

Second Semester 2021:
•Third Playable Character (Spark)
• First Boss (Glacien)
• Star Store
•Glaciem as a Playable Character
• Second Boss (Aeon)
•Aeon as a Playable Character
•World 4 (Peak of the Fog)
